body.name: all-intervention partial-projection condition
body.construction: For \(u\in\mathcal D_{(U_C,U_X,B,S)}\), \(J\subseteq W=(C,X,Y)\), and \(j\in\mathcal D_J\), let \((j^o,j^u)=\omega(j)\). Let \(w_j^u\) equal the residual solution \(Z_{s,j}\), with \(Z_{s,j}=j_X\) when \(X\in J\) and \(Z_{s,j}=g_s(C_j,S)\) when \(X\notin J\). Require \(\delta(w_j^o,w_j^u)=W_j^{\mathcal M_s}(u)\), \(\delta(j^o,j^u)=j\), and \(w_j^o=\mathcal M_{H,s,[j^o]}(u,j^u,z^u)\) for every compatible nonintervened residual argument \(z^u\). Here \([j^o]\) is SCM surgery on observed coordinates and residual surgery is used exactly when \(X\in J\).
